introduction: Nevada’s Energy Assistance Program accepts a completed application with supporting records through several DSS routes. Tell the agency about a shutoff notice when requesting help.
description: Nevada’s Energy Assistance Program accepts a completed application with supporting records through several DSS routes. Tell the agency about a shutoff notice when requesting h

sections.who: DSS reviews household income and other program criteria. The agency asks for income evidence for every household member and documentation about the heating or cooling account.
sections.get: Approved assistance offsets qualifying home-energy costs. Ask DSS how the payment will be applied and whether a specialized crisis option fits your situation.
sections.docs:
• Income for every household member for at least the last 30 days.
  • Head-of-household identity and requested status records.
  • The most recent heating or cooling bills.
  • If the bill is in another person’s name, their signed authorization with contact details.
  • An explanation of how expenses are met when they exceed income.
sections.apply:
1. Get the current application

    Use the EAP application page, which includes accessible and Spanish forms.

  2. Submit the completed packet

    DSS lists mail, fax, office drop boxes, lobbies and energyassistance@dss.nv.gov. Intake sites can help complete and mail it.

  3. Follow agency requests

    Save a copy and confirm receipt. Ask about additional evidence and any pending utility deadline.
sections.after: Prior recipients should ask when they may reapply: the state currently describes an interval of approximately 11 months after the previous benefit. Confirm any unpaid balance with the utility.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using Nevada EAP application and evidence requirements. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: What if the account is not in my name?
DSS requests a signed statement from the named person authorizing the application and providing their address and phone.
Can an intake site help with the form?
Yes. The state says intake sites assist with completion and mailing.
Can I apply again immediately after an award?
The published instructions say prior recipients generally wait approximately 11 months; confirm your case with EAP.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
